claim: No blanket HyperFrames animation parity claim is made.

capabilities.difference: Slate supports a closed recipe vocabulary, interruption, themes, slide-local time, and automatic SVG/card/metric choreography; it does not expose arbitrary authored WAAPI.
Slate animates internal path/shape geometry with deterministic WAAPI; HyperFrames supports a broader SVG morph/path/plugin surface.
Static validation and direct holds exist; pixel snapshots and keyframe-strip diagnostics remain planned.
Cut, crossfade, and shared-axis behavior are implemented; HyperFrames transition catalog breadth is not.
Slate uses stable fragment IDs and relative slide-local holds rather than one continuous composition clock.
Same-origin BroadcastChannel sync and local notes exist; remote transport and multi-screen placement are not baseline.
